We welcome Tenant CVs from HomeHak.com as applications for this property. Shortlist this property in your HomeHak account if you would like status updates.


Absolute Property Management is delighted to offer for let this two bedroom fully furnished apartment with balcony overlooking the River Lee. Located in the popular and gated development of Fisherman's Wharf which is ideally located just off Washington Street with all amenities close by including local shops and social outlets. Close proximity to Cork City Centre, UCC, the Mercy University Hospital and the Tyndall Institute. Accommodation includes an entrance hallway, open plan living / dining room, fully fitted kitchen, two double bedrooms and a bathroom. The apartment is serviced by a lift and an intercom system is installed. Refuse included.
